image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a single beige adhesive bandage (Band-Aid) resting on a textured, light gray fabric surface. The bandage is oriented diagonally. It features a central white absorbent pad and tan adhesive wings with visible perforations. The lighting is soft, casting subtle shadows that suggest the bandage is slightly raised from the fabric.
